title: Why did Van Gogh cut off his ear? || Van Gogh Questions #1
speaker: Van Gogh Museum
zh: 【Van Gogh Museum】梵谷為什麼要割掉自己的耳朵？ ||梵谷問題 #1（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Why did Van Gogh cut off his ear and what was the nature of his illness?
cues.en: Why did Van Gogh cut off his ear and what was the nature of his illness?
cues.zh: 梵谷為什麼要割掉自己的耳朵？他的病的性質是什麼？

cues.text: We are often asked questions like this...
cues.en: We are often asked questions like this...
cues.zh: 我們常被問到這樣的問題...

cues.text: but as you can imagine it's hard to give a definitive answer.
cues.en: but as you can imagine it's hard to give a definitive answer.
cues.zh: 但正如你可以想像的那樣，很難給出明確的答案。

cues.text: In the fall of 1888...
cues.en: In the fall of 1888...

cues.text: Vincent van Gogh was living and working with the artist Paul Gauguin...
cues.en: Vincent van Gogh was living and working with the artist Paul Gauguin...
cues.zh: 文森梵谷與藝術家保羅高更一起生活和工作...

cues.text: in the Yellow House in Arles in the south of France.
cues.en: in the Yellow House in Arles in the south of France.
cues.zh: 在法國南部阿爾勒的黃色房子裡。

cues.text: Late in the evening of Sunday 23rd December...
cues.en: Late in the evening of Sunday 23rd December...
cues.zh: 12 月 23 日星期日深夜...

cues.text: the two artists had a blazing row.
cues.en: the two artists had a blazing row.
cues.zh: 兩位藝術家發生了激烈的爭吵。

cues.text: During an attack Vincent cut off his left ear.
cues.en: During an attack Vincent cut off his left ear.
cues.zh: 在一次襲擊中，文森特割掉了他的左耳。

cues.text: He wrapped it in a piece of paper...
cues.en: He wrapped it in a piece of paper...
cues.zh: 他用一張紙包起來…

cues.text: and presented it to a prostitute at a local brothel.
cues.en: and presented it to a prostitute at a local brothel.
cues.zh: 並將其送給當地妓院的妓女。

cues.text: The next morning police found Vincent at home and took him to hospital.
cues.en: The next morning police found Vincent at home and took him to hospital.
cues.zh: 第二天早上，警方在家中找到了文森特，並將他送往醫院。

cues.text: A young doctor called Felix Rey treated Vincent and confirmed...
cues.en: A young doctor called Felix Rey treated Vincent and confirmed...
cues.zh: 一位名叫菲利克斯·雷伊的年輕醫生對文森特進行了治療，並證實…

cues.text: he had cut off his whole left ear.
cues.en: he had cut off his whole left ear.
cues.zh: 他割掉了整個左耳。

cues.text: Gauguin sent a telegram to Vincent's brother Theo...
cues.en: Gauguin sent a telegram to Vincent's brother Theo...
cues.zh: 高更給文森的弟弟西奧發了一封電報…

cues.text: who caught the night train to Arles that same evening...
cues.en: who caught the night train to Arles that same evening...
cues.zh: 當天晚上搭夜車到阿爾勒......

cues.text: to be at his brother's bedside.
cues.en: to be at his brother's bedside.
cues.zh: 守在哥哥的床邊。

cues.text: After roughly a week in hospital Vincent regained his senses.
cues.en: After roughly a week in hospital Vincent regained his senses.
cues.zh: 在醫院大約一週後，文森特恢復了知覺。

cues.text: He recalled little of what had happened...
cues.en: He recalled little of what had happened...
cues.zh: 他幾乎不記得發生了什麼事…

cues.text: and more than anything he just wanted to forget about his illness.
cues.en: and more than anything he just wanted to forget about his illness.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，他只想忘記自己的病。

cues.text: He tried to assure his brother Theo that his confusion had been nothing more...
cues.en: He tried to assure his brother Theo that his confusion had been nothing more...
cues.zh: 他試圖向他的兄弟西奧保證，他的困惑只不過是…

cues.text: than as he called it...
cues.en: than as he called it...
cues.zh: 比他所謂的...

cues.text: Unfortunately, Vincent suffered new attacks just a month later.
cues.en: Unfortunately, Vincent suffered new attacks just a month later.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，僅僅一個月後，文森特就遭受了新的攻擊。

cues.text: He now had to accept that he was suffering from a mental illness...
cues.en: He now had to accept that he was suffering from a mental illness...
cues.zh: 現在他不得不承認自己患有精神疾病…

cues.text: and he had to learn to live with the frightening thought...
cues.en: and he had to learn to live with the frightening thought...
cues.zh: 他必須學會忍受這個可怕的想法…

cues.text: that an attack could happen at any time.
cues.en: that an attack could happen at any time.
cues.zh: 攻擊隨時可能發生。

cues.text: Vincent himself described it as...
cues.en: Vincent himself described it as...
cues.zh: 文森特本人將其描述為...

cues.text: What caused these reoccurring attacks? There are many theories.
cues.en: What caused these reoccurring attacks? There are many theories.
cues.zh: 是什麼導致了這些反覆發生的攻擊？有很多理論。

cues.text: Some more plausible than others.
cues.en: Some more plausible than others.
cues.zh: 有些比其他更合理。

cues.text: However, an all-embracing diagnosis is yet to be found.
cues.en: However, an all-embracing diagnosis is yet to be found.
cues.zh: 然而，尚未找到全面的診斷。

cues.text: Eyewitness accounts from the time are the best way...
cues.en: Eyewitness accounts from the time are the best way...
cues.zh: 當時目擊者的敘述是最好的方法...

cues.text: of understanding Vincent's illness.
cues.en: of understanding Vincent's illness.
cues.zh: 瞭解文森的病情。

cues.text: When he cut off his ear...
cues.en: When he cut off his ear...
cues.zh: 當他割掉自己的耳朵時...

cues.text: Vincent had been living and working in the Yellow House with Paul Gauguin...
cues.en: Vincent had been living and working in the Yellow House with Paul Gauguin...
cues.zh: 文森一直和保羅高更一起在黃房子裡生活和工作...

cues.text: for just over two months. By inviting Gauguin to work with him...
cues.en: for just over two months. By inviting Gauguin to work with him...
cues.zh: 僅僅兩個多月。邀請高更與他一起工作......

cues.text: he had set the bar extraordinarily high.
cues.en: he had set the bar extraordinarily high.
cues.zh: 他把標準定得非常高。

cues.text: Vincent felt under huge pressure to perform.
cues.en: Vincent felt under huge pressure to perform.
cues.zh: 文森感受到了巨大的表演壓力。

cues.text: He was still developing his own style and hoped to learn from Gauguin...
cues.en: He was still developing his own style and hoped to learn from Gauguin...
cues.zh: 他仍在發展自己的風格，並希望向高更學習…

cues.text: an older and more experienced artist.
cues.en: an older and more experienced artist.
cues.zh: 一位年長且更有經驗的藝術家。

cues.text: The artists worked well together to start with...
cues.en: The artists worked well together to start with...
cues.zh: 藝術家們合作得很好，從...

cues.text: but their relationship soon turned sour.
cues.en: but their relationship soon turned sour.
cues.zh: 但他們的關係很快就惡化了。

cues.text: Vincent was stressed and worried that Gauguin may leave.
cues.en: Vincent was stressed and worried that Gauguin may leave.
cues.zh: 文森特感到壓力很大，擔心高更可能會離開。

cues.text: Thoughts that may have pushed him over the edge.
cues.en: Thoughts that may have pushed him over the edge.
cues.zh: 這些想法可能把他推到了崩潰的邊緣。

cues.text: Add in Vincent's heavy drinking and his nervous character...
cues.en: Add in Vincent's heavy drinking and his nervous character...
cues.zh: 再加上文森的酗酒和他緊張的性格…

cues.text: and you start to get an idea of what might have caused the incident.
cues.en: and you start to get an idea of what might have caused the incident.
cues.zh: 然後您開始瞭解可能導致該事件的原因。

cues.text: But, like I said before...
cues.en: But, like I said before...
cues.zh: 但是，正如我之前所說...

cues.text: we don't know for sure what kind of illness Vincent suffered from.
cues.en: we don't know for sure what kind of illness Vincent suffered from.
cues.zh: 我們不確定文森特患的是哪一種病。

cues.text: Many people later came to view Vincent's illness...
cues.en: Many people later came to view Vincent's illness...
cues.zh: 後來很多人來看文森的病…

cues.text: as the true source of his creativity.
cues.en: as the true source of his creativity.
cues.zh: 作為他創造力的真正泉源。

cues.text: However, the only time he actually painted while suffering an attack...
cues.en: However, the only time he actually painted while suffering an attack...
cues.zh: 然而，他唯一一次真正在遭受攻擊時作畫…

cues.text: was a period in the early spring of 1890.
cues.en: was a period in the early spring of 1890.
cues.zh: 那是1890年早春的一段時期。

cues.text: His artistic achievement was certainly not a side-effect of his illness.
cues.en: His artistic achievement was certainly not a side-effect of his illness.
cues.zh: 他的藝術成就當然不是他疾病的副作用。

cues.text: It was rooted in the skills of his craft which he worked hard to develop.
cues.en: It was rooted in the skills of his craft which he worked hard to develop.
cues.zh: 它植根於他努力發展的工藝技能。

cues.text: He wrote...
cues.en: He wrote...
cues.zh: 他寫...

cues.text: He clung to Theo's letters and threw himself into his work.
cues.en: He clung to Theo's letters and threw himself into his work.
cues.zh: 他緊緊抓住西奧的信，全心投入工作。

cues.text: Despite his inner despair, Vincent wanted to go on living...
cues.en: Despite his inner despair, Vincent wanted to go on living...
cues.zh: 儘管內心絕望，文森特還是想繼續活下去…

cues.text: and was deeply motivated to keep working.
cues.en: and was deeply motivated to keep working.
cues.zh: 並深受繼續工作的動力。
